metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said 'Sure, take it, I’m on break' LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get gifted a kill for doing basically nothing?
Enemy must’ve been busy checking their phone.
Click if your aim is a joke but the scoreboard lies!
Valorant logic at its finest again.

Tap if your best kills are pure accident chaos!
